spreads.name: Before you delegate
spreads.description: Three words to hold before handing a task to a system.

positions.label: Access
positions.meaning: What a system can reach and change: accounts, money, code, other systems.

positions.label: Channel
positions.meaning: A path by which a system can act on, or talk to, something outside its task.

positions.label: What held
positions.meaning: For any action a system took or did not take, the name of the thing that decided it: inner rule, outer rule, presence, or nothing.

spreads.name: The fork
spreads.description: Two alignments, and the choice between the two geopolitics.

positions.label: Human-human alignment
positions.meaning: Whether the humans holding a capability share the interests of everyone else.

positions.label: Human-AI alignment
positions.meaning: Whether the system itself shares the interests of everyone else, once no human is in the loop.

positions.label: The two geopolitics
positions.meaning: The bad-actor frame says keep it from them, and tends to race. The alignment frame says keep it from everyone, and tends to stop.

positions.label: The word for now
positions.meaning: The word that seems most alive in your situation today.
